title: 广义智能体迭代：迭代策略改进与递归自我改进的统一形式化框架
summary: 论文提出广义智能体迭代（GAI）框架，将迭代策略改进与递归自我改进（RSI）统一为同一学习范式的两种情形。GAI将智能体定义为系统中可修改组件的配置，学习过程建模为智能体评估与改进的循环，并通过两个关键维度区分不同实例：改进机制是否属于智能体、衡量标准是否外在于智能体。前者划分GPI与RSI边界，后者决定系统极性。
summary_en: The paper proposes Generalized Agent Iteration (GAI), a formal framework unifying iterative policy improvement and recursive self-improvement (RSI) as two cases of a single learning paradigm. GAI defines the agent as a configuration of modifiable components and models learning as a cycle of agent evaluation and improvement, distinguished by two dials: whether the improving mechanism is part of the agent, and whether the standard is grounded outside it.
